reason: This plugin is a user-facing DeepSeek Harness mode extension that adds a third UI segment called Code, placing a live terminal as the main conversation column. Evidence shows it mainly embeds and hosts `omdsh-tui` via a websocket (`/omdsh-codemode/terminal`) in the active workspace context, reusing conversation session IDs for resume/reconnect behavior rather than reimplementing terminal functionality. It is primarily a terminal + workspace workflow integration plugin with session/sidebar coordination features.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 中新增“代码模式”面板，在会话页面侧边切换到代码区并启动显示终端，供用户在当前工作区继续进行命令行操作。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a Code mode view in DeepSeek Harness, opening and displaying a terminal panel in the same session workspace so users can work in a command-line environment there.

capabilities: Starts and manages workspace terminal sessions for the web interface.
Exposes a terminal websocket endpoint for interactive I/O.
Bridges terminal session output into the harness conversation/session workflow.
Allows configurable launcher settings (`command`/`args`/profile) for terminal process invocation.

reasons.code: README states the plugin adds a Code mode segment that replaces the conversation view with a terminal and uses `dsh --session-id` tied to the conversation.
README documents socket endpoint `GET /omdsh-codemode/terminal` and socket-based terminal relay behavior, including resume/reconnect flow.
package.json declares terminal-related dependencies (`node-pty`, `ws`, xterm) and web UI/client runtime/plugin wiring required for live terminal rendering and transport.
README describes optional configuration for `command` and `args` to launch the terminal process, which makes command execution behavior configurable by deployment settings.
